in_sanskrit.name: Rafeek
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Rain
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Rafeek एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the word 'Ravi' which means 'sun' and 'Fikr' which means 'thought' or 'deep contemplation', Rafeek is a Hindu name which signifies the deep thought and contemplation during the rainy season when the sun is hidden, and the earth is nourished by the rains.
